result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout problem with cut-off content, and minor issues with category filter and card visibility.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card and the pizza discount card at the bottom are cut off at the right/bottom edge of the screen, indicating horizontal and vertical scroll content is not clearly indicated
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable cards show a partial preview intentionally with clear affordance (e.g., gradient fade) and vertically cut content should have proper scroll indication or padding

issues.description: The category filter pills (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off on the right side, suggesting more categories exist off-screen without a clear scroll indicator
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visible pill to indicate horizontal scrollability of the category filter

issues.description: The pizza discount card at the bottom lacks a visible restaurant name/title, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it
issues.suggestion: Ensure all promotional/restaurant cards have consistent visible titles and details before being cut off by the viewport
